summary: The study demonstrates the use of atomic layer deposition (ALD) to produce high-quality, single-crystalline epitaxial BiFeO3 thin films on SrTiO3(001) substrates at ∼450 °C. The process involves sequential delivery of Bi(mmp)3 and Fe(C5H5)2 precursors, followed by ozone oxidation. The films are annealed at 700 °C to achieve crystallization and epitaxial growth, resulting in phase-pure, misfit dislocation-free BiFeO3 films with excellent crystalline quality.
evidence: We report how a low vacuum pressure process followed by a few-minute annealing enables epitaxial stabilization, producing high-quality, phase-pure, single-crystalline epitaxial, and misfit dislocation-free BiFeO3(001) thin films on SrTiO3(001) at ∼450 °C less than current routes.
